hired_hands.estado.curandose: Healing before going back into the mine

hired_hands.overlay.en_mina_espera: is inside the mine. Back in %s min and will wait there.

hired_hands.aviso.sin_cofre: there's no chest near my post.

hired_hands.orden.esperar_mina: I'm inside the mine: when I come out I'll wait.

hired_hands.orden.trabajar: I'm getting to work as a %s here.
hired_hands.orden.buscar: Looking for %s: I'll dig stairs down to layer Y %s and branch mine.
hired_hands.orden.buscar_cantidad: Looking for %s %s: I'll dig stairs down to layer Y %s and branch mine.

hired_hands.local.a_por_cantidad: Going for %s %s. I'll head down to layer Y %s the way you're facing.

hired_hands.quehaces.contrato_dias: I have %s days left on my contract

hired_hands.saludo.libre.0: Looking for a sword for hire? I charge %s emeralds.
hired_hands.saludo.libre.1: Hello, stranger. For %s emeralds I'll work for you.
hired_hands.saludo.libre.2: If you need a hand, it's %s emeralds.
hired_hands.ia.sin_clave: (To chat with mercenaries, the server needs an Anthropic API key in config/hired_hands-common.toml. Simple orders still work.)
hired_hands.ia.respiro: needs a break: too many questions in a row.
hired_hands.ia.pensando: is still thinking about your last message.
hired_hands.manual.0.texto:
The Patron's Handbook

• Hiring
• Orders
• Trades
• The chest
• Night
• Talking to them
hired_hands.manual.1.texto:
Free mercenaries show up near villages. Right-click one with 10 emeralds in hand and it works for you for 5 days.

Or use a Mercenary Contract on the ground.
hired_hands.manual.2.texto:
Each emerald you give adds 1 day (sneak to pay the whole stack).

It warns you when less than a day is left. When it ends, it leaves.
hired_hands.manual.3.texto:
Right-click with an empty hand:

Following you
→ Waiting
→ Working
→ Following you

A mercenary only has Following and On guard.
hired_hands.manual.4.texto:
Sneak, empty hand: its screen (gear, backpack, orders, group).
Stick: gives back its gear.
Food: heals it.
Weapon, tool or armor: it equips it.
hired_hands.manual.5.texto:
Sword or bow: mercenary
Axe: lumberjack
Pickaxe: miner
Hoe: farmer
Fishing rod: fisher
Shears: rancher
Bundle: hauler
Bowl: cook
hired_hands.manual.6.texto:
Bring it to the spot and set it to Working. It works within 16 blocks.

Place a chest or barrel within 5 blocks: it leaves what it gathers there.
hired_hands.manual.7.texto:
If its tool wears out, it takes another from the chest.

If it's hurt, it eats food from the chest.

Leave tools and food there.
hired_hands.manual.8.texto:
Chops natural trees: never your houses.

For tall trees it pillars up. It replants and picks up saplings. Give it dirt or stone for the pillar.
hired_hands.manual.9.texto:
Right-click it with a mineral (a diamond, iron...) or say "Rodrigo, find 10 diamonds".

It digs stairs down the way you face to that mineral's layer and branch mines.
hired_hands.manual.10.texto:
Diamond and redstone: Y -58
Gold: Y -16
Lapis: Y 0
Iron: Y 16
Copper: Y 48
Coal: Y 96

With no target, it mines at its post's height.
hired_hands.manual.11.texto:
Give it cobblestone (seals lava, water and holes), torches and a chest: it places it at the bottom of the mine and stores loot there.

Keep a spare pickaxe in its backpack or the chest.
hired_hands.manual.12.texto:
With a Mine Entrance near its post, it goes in and comes back with ores.

Diamonds: entrance below Y 0 and an iron pickaxe or better.
hired_hands.manual.13.texto:
Recipe:

Logs on top.
Cobblestone, iron pickaxe, cobblestone.
Cobblestone, rail, cobblestone.

If hurt, it heals before going in.
hired_hands.manual.14.texto:
The farmer harvests and replants wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, melons, pumpkins and sugar cane.

The fisher finds open water nearby and fishes from the shore.
hired_hands.manual.15.texto:
At night workers stop (except the miner) and sleep in a bed near their post.

They heal faster while sleeping.
hired_hands.manual.16.texto:
Type its name in chat and what you want:

"Rodrigo, follow me"
"Rodrigo, stay here"
"Rodrigo, chop"
"Rodrigo, what are you doing?"
hired_hands.manual.17.texto:
It always understands simple orders.

If the server has AI enabled, you can also chat with it or give more complex orders: it remembers what you said recently.
hired_hands.aviso.nivel: I reached level %s! I'm stronger and work faster now.
hired_hands.cuerno.esperan: %s hired hands wait where they are
hired_hands.cuerno.desc: Right-click: your nearby hired hands follow you. Sneak: they wait where they are.
hired_hands.grupo.nadie_grupo: (You have no hired hands of group %s nearby. Set the group in their screen.)
hired_hands.grupo.solo_sencillas: (Groups only take simple orders: follow me, stay, chop...)
hired_hands.estado.sin_cocina: Nothing to cook (needs furnaces, food or fuel)
hired_hands.vara.desc: Right-click two blocks to mark an area, then right-click a worker: it only works there. Sneak-click it to clear the area.
hired_hands.vara.esquina1: Corner 1: %s. Now mark the opposite corner.
hired_hands.vara.zona: Area marked: %s x %s. Right-click a worker.
hired_hands.vara.muy_grande: Area too big (max %s blocks per side).
hired_hands.vara.falta: Mark two corners with the rod first.
hired_hands.vara.asignada: I'll work in this area (%s x %s).
hired_hands.vara.quitada: Back to working around my post.
hired_hands.manual.18.texto:
They level up by working and fighting (up to 10).

Each level: more health, more damage and faster work. Miners bring more from expeditions.
hired_hands.manual.19.texto:
Set its group (1 to 4) in its screen.

In chat:
"all, follow me"
"group 2, stay"

Command Horn: everyone follows; sneak, they wait.
hired_hands.manual.20.texto:
Shears, breeds, and culls extras (10 per species).

Give it wheat, carrots or seeds, or leave them in the chest.
hired_hands.manual.21.texto:
The hauler brings everything from the chests in its area to its post's chest.

The cook runs furnaces and smokers with raw food and coal from the chest.
hired_hands.manual.22.texto:
Foreman's Rod: click two blocks to mark an area, then click the worker.

Holding the rod shows its area.
